title.narrative: Improving Energy Efficiency through Electricity Generation from Biogas in Wastewater Treatment Plants

description.narrative:
With the water-energy nexus project ¿Improving Energy Efficiency through Electricity Generation from Biogas in Wastewater Treatment Plants¿, WAJ and KfW aim at increasing the energy efficiency of two wastewater treatment plants (WWTP) in Jordan by converting biogas into electricity. Investments will be made in the following WWTPs: Component 1: South Amman Component 2: Jerash West.

The total costs of the project are estimated at EUR 59.5 million. The NIP EU grant amount of EUR 10 million will finance partly Component 2, a part of the contingencies for both WWTP, as well as the communication activities
